paragraphs: Rav Huna bar Ashi said in the name of Rav. See [Sotah 16b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sotah.16b.3).[^1]

notes.text: The linked Gemara and [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=963&lang=en) give Rav Huna bar Ashi as the transmitter and Rav as the source. Heilprin adds his own chronological identification of Ashi.
